annotation.title_clean: The Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) (Automated Vehicles) Order 2022
annotation.title_en: The Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) (Automated Vehicles) Order 2022
annotation.authors_or_issuer: King's Printer of Acts of Parliament (Secretary of State for Transport, UK)
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument modifying regulation 109(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 so drivers of automated vehicles may view information on built-in displays while the vehicle is driving itself and not requesting takeover. In force 1 July 2022, applying in England, Wales and Scotland.
key_provisions_or_claims: Modifies reg. 109(1) of the 1986 Construction and Use Regulations for automated vehicles
Permits viewing built-in display information when the vehicle is driving itself
Not permitted when the vehicle requests the driver to take over
Applies to automated vehicles as defined in the Automated and Electric Vehicles Act 2018
In force 1 July 2022; extends to England, Wales and Scotland
